ارتهنت (form VIII)

# اِرْتَهَنْتَ (irtahanta) /ir.ta.han.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# اِرْتَهَنْتِ (irtahanti) /ir.ta.han.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# اِرْتَهَنَتْ (irtahanat) /ir.ta.ha.nat/: third-perso
